spec_match.rationale: Targets getPathSegmentAtLength(distance) exactly, pairs it with the clearly-labelled pre-existing getPointAtLength, and encodes the spec's four clamping edges (negative→first, overshoot→last, NaN→null, empty→null) as runnable probes.

interactive.rationale: Distance slider moves the marker live (verified: cx moved from 15 at d=0 to 109.6 at d=150) and drives the segment answer plus row highlight; a button runs the four edge probes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises the slider walk, segment highlight, and clamping contract; all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Clamping, NaN, empty path, method-absent builds, and the mid-implementation partial-surface case (getPathData present without getPathSegmentAtLength — the state this environment actually exhibits) are each handled with distinct honest copy.

conformance.rationale: The suite asserts the method's typeof plus the NaN-null and negative-clamp contracts — the same edges the page probes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153 (Playwright CDP; chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable) verified the marker walk, honest method-absent verdicts in both flag modes, clean console/network, and both-viewport screenshots — but the method is absent even behind the flag on this build, so the success path (segment answer + row highlight + clamp passes) could not be runtime-verified here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts answer shape when supported, clamping contract when runnable, and the explicit fallback branches otherwise.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; active row highlight uses bg-stone with charcoal text; slider uses accent-color.

accessibility.rationale: Slider has a visible label with live value text and aria-describedby to the readout; marker position is mirrored in text; table rows highlight with text equivalents in the readout.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3; slider is full-width with a 44px hit area; kv grid stacks under 480px.

openQuestions.title: Runtime-verify the success path once a build ships getPathSegmentAtLength
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 153 behind --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI ships getPathData/setPathData but not getPathSegmentAtLength, so the segment answer, row highlight, and the four clamp probes have only been exercised through their honest-absent branches. Re-run on Chrome 159 (or any build where 'getPathSegmentAtLength' in SVGPathElement.prototype is true) and confirm the highlight tracks the slider and all four clamp probes pass.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider input accessible labeling and keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep native range inputs (arrow-key operable) and reflect the value in text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native input[type=range] with accent-color styling only; the current distance and total render as text in the label.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates live region after button action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair visual highlights with text equivalents in a live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The highlighted row is restated in the aria-live readout ('the pen is inside segment #N (C)…').

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Scoped headers + scrollable wrapper for data tables.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Segment table uses th scope=col inside .table-wrap.

summary: Built and verified 2026-10-25 in the weekly hardening coverage sweep. This is the one concept whose success path cannot run anywhere in this environment: getPathSegmentAtLength is absent on Chromium 153 both unflagged and behind SVGPathDataAPI, and the page states that exact partial-surface condition rather than blaming browser age. The marker visualization (pre-existing getPointAtLength, labelled as such) keeps the page useful meanwhile; slider, probes, fallbacks, console, network, and both-viewport screenshots all verified clean.
